principles.requirement: The policy is a single-asset account Trader using causal market state, authoritative account-derived state and necessary causal history; it is not a market-only predictor or macro allocator.

observable_evidence.claim: Actor observation contains causal market plus account projection without forbidden identity shortcuts.
Known-answer account states with the same market observation can require different actions.
Closed loop proves the policy actually acts through account consequences.

principles.requirement: Experience is generated by repeated policy interaction: nominal action, permission, actual execution, account consequence and the next policy decision on the resulting account.

observable_evidence.claim: Each policy call consumes the actual previous account consequence.
Collector qualification proves repeated policy calls and continuous account evolution.

principles.requirement: Existing legal experience may be replayed repeatedly and changed policies must also be able to generate new legal account trajectories.

observable_evidence.claim: Compatible historical sequences can be sampled repeatedly under explicit probabilities.
Historical/new replay mixture and generation learning remain attributable.

principles.requirement: Account economic consequences persist across chunks, pause/resume, process restart, learner updates and generation switches without hidden reset or free recapitalization.

observable_evidence.claim: Corrected execution/account semantics conserve complete economic consequences.
Uninterrupted and pause/resume account trajectories are semantically identical.
Checkpoint switch preserves capital, positions, clocks and pending consequences.

principles.requirement: Trading risk and exit choices belong to the model; the environment enforces genuine market, exchange, account and user-resource mechanics but not hidden strategy preferences.

observable_evidence.claim: Every forced execution behavior has an explicit source classification.
Historical SL/TP/max-hold contamination is rejected while genuine liquidation remains active.

principles.requirement: The primary economic preference is complete arithmetic expected return under an explicit cohort, capital denominator, weighting, common horizon and baseline; failures remain in the denominator.

observable_evidence.claim: Arithmetic rewards telescope to authoritative equity change including liabilities.
Higher-bankruptcy policy is preferred when its complete arithmetic expectation is analytically higher.
Economic comparison binds common cohort, horizon, capital, baselines and failures.

principles.requirement: Raw facts, replay admission, demonstration selection and evaluation cohorts are separate views; successful and failed outcomes remain preserved.

observable_evidence.claim: Liquidation, liability, rejection and reversal failure facts remain persisted.
Demonstration filtering cannot alter raw facts or the evaluation denominator.

principles.requirement: Market sensory organs remain frozen while declared account, fusion, Actor and Critic paths are trainable and must receive only their authorized gradients.

observable_evidence.claim: Frozen organs have zero mutation while eligible trainable paths receive gradients.
Learner updates Actor/Critic ownership without mutating frozen organs or legacy Teacher/Student.

principles.requirement: A registered collection unit uses a fixed behavior checkpoint; learning occurs on a separate copy, generation switches preserve the logical account, and compatible history is not erased by age.

observable_evidence.claim: Behavior policy hash is invariant inside a registered collection unit.
Generation switch preserves account and clock continuity with exact lineage.
Generation, attribution, replay mixture and retention qualification are compiled.

principles.requirement: Evidence claims are explicitly scoped as contract, component, closed-loop, known-answer, economic or transfer and may never exceed the strongest evidence actually produced.

observable_evidence.claim: A component-only fixture cannot serialize an ECONOMIC or TRANSFER claim.
Missing dependencies or required checks prevent a PASS receipt.
Final compiler limits canonical readiness and evidence ceiling to actual gate receipts.
